Ravi: Quick sync  CloudWave reseller wants a joint POC. Key asks: sandbox entitlement flow, SSO mapping (SAML), telemetry defaults, OEM SDK licensing, and a provisional POC price. Who can pick this up?
Jules: Ill own entitlement + billing mapping. We need a webhook for marketplace entitlements and a mapping doc (reseller_customer_id -> redwood_org_id). Ask CloudWave for their trial SKU metadata.
Maya: Security checklist: no model weights distributed, TLS1.3, option for mTLS for private connectors, KMS ownership (they prefer to hold keys), telemetry off by default for reseller builds. Will send the questionnaire.
Sam: Pricing idea  offer 30-day sandbox: bundled 2M token credit + reserved 1x node for pilot; overage priced per 1k requests for cache-misses. Also offer per-seat license for their OEM installer if legal signs off. Drafting numbers.
Ravi: They want to anonymize email fields client-side and run a local LRU cache. Any blockers?
Maya: Client-side pseudonymization OK; hashing hurts embeddings. Recommend deterministic pseudonymization + small eval (200 rows). Local LRU cache fine if SDK exposes CacheAdapter and never persists model artifacts.
Jules: Entitlement webhook example ready; will post spec in the channel and include revoke flow.
Sam: Ill include telemetry opt-in language and support SLAs for the pilot in the quote. :+1:
calendar-bot: Event created: "CloudWave reseller POC kickoff"  Thu 9:30 AM PT. Invite sent.
Ravi: Thanks  please drop drafts into #partnerships/cloudwave before the call.
